$comment: Every oasisai.work address the product may publish as a contact (legal pages, unsubscribe page, error pages, support copy, compliance manifests). An address belongs here only after a person has confirmed it receives mail: it exists as a Google Workspace user, alias or group, and a test message sent to it arrived. tests/verified-mailboxes.test.ts fails the build when the product publishes an oasisai.work address that is not listed. On 2026-09-30 the only verified inbox is conaugh@oasisai.work (Gmail send-as lists it, and it receives mail daily). privacy@, legal@, dmca@, support@ and unsubscribe@ were published for months and never existed.
